title: 스파이 게임
ctx: Film 「Spy Game」(2001, Universal, director Tony Scott). Robert Redford as Nathan Muir, a veteran CIA case officer on his last day before retirement in 1991; Brad Pitt as Tom Bishop, the agent Muir recruited in Vietnam, now arrested in a Chinese prison in Su Chou for trying to free Elizabeth Hadley and due to be executed in 24 hours; Catherine McCormack as Elizabeth Hadley, an aid worker Bishop loved in Beirut; Stephen Dillane as Charles Harker; Larry Bryggman as Troy Folger; Marianne Jean-Baptiste as Gladys Jennip, Muir's secretary. Through flashbacks (Vietnam 1975, Berlin 1976, Beirut 1985) Muir tells CIA officials Bishop's story while secretly running 'Operation Dinner Out' with his life savings to rescue Bishop.
